articles.summary: An open line system, or open optical line system (OLS), is the optical line layer of a dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) network, deployed and managed as its own system so that it can carry wavelengths generated by other vendors' equipment. It holds the amplifiers, multiplexer/demultiplexer (mux/demux) filters and reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexers (ROADMs). The transponders that create the wavelengths sit outside it, and the operator can buy them separately.
articles.title: What Is an Open Line System (OLS)?
